mails.subject: Following up after the Copenhagen workshop week
mails.body:
Hello,

I hope this finds you well. We met briefly at the Copenhagen workshop week and I wanted to reach out about a potential partnership between Northwave Collaborative and your community.

Our network includes creators and teams from several countries, and we believe your space could be an ideal host for some of our activities. We would love to discuss how we might support each other, share ideas and grow together.

If you are interested, I would be glad to set up an introduction call with our team. We are flexible on format and timing.

Looking forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Ingrid Solberg
Northwave Collaborative
mails.justification: Vague partnership approach referring to a meeting that did not take place, with no concrete proposal. The sender has no relationship with the space and the message was never requested.

mails.subject: Lancement de notre nouvelle collection de bureaux
mails.body:
Bonjour à toutes et à tous,

Ce week-end, nous avons le plaisir de vous annoncer le lancement de la collection Atelier, notre nouvelle gamme de bureaux modulaires et de mobilier pour espaces partagés.

Pour fêter ça, une conférence en ligne gratuite aura lieu le jeudi 15 octobre à 18h. Nos designers y présenteront les pièces, les matériaux et les finitions, et répondront aux questions en direct.

Une remise de lancement de 15 % s'applique à toute commande passée avant le 31 octobre.

On y dévoilera aussi en avant-première les prochaines couleurs de la saison, ainsi que notre programme pour les professionnels.

Réservez votre place : studio-clemence.example/atelier

À très bientôt,
L'équipe Studio Clémence

mails.subject: Re: Re: introduction from the networking dinner
mails.body:
hi, sorry for the delay, sent from my phone so keep it short

It was great speaking with you at the dinner last week. As promised I wanted to send over the details about our offer. We are a small group of investors and creators who connect with spaces like yours, and we think there is real potential in a joint programme, maybe a series of mixed events, maybe something bigger.

I know this sounds vague, but things are moving fast on our side and I would rather talk than write long emails. We have partners lined up in Sweden, Germany and the Netherlands, and a Copenhagen base would be perfect.

Would you have 20 minutes on Tuesday or Wednesday? I can also come by in person if easier.

One more thing: if you can send me the name of the person who manages events there, I will reach out to them directly, that would save us both some time.

Thanks a lot and talk soon
Daniel

Sent from my iPhone
mails.justification: Fake 'we met' partnership pitch with no substance and typical vagueness, no real prior contact. The sender has no relationship with the space and the message was never requested.
